## What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the use case. What are you trying to do, and why is the current
installer flow making it hard?

## Proposed solution

A clear description of the change you'd like to see. If you have more than
one idea, describe each briefly.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're using today, or other designs you thought about.

## Platform

- [ ] Linux
- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] All platforms

## Additional context

Anything else — links to related issues, references to how other installers
solve the same problem, etc.
